description: This file contains implementation logic for diffcore break operations in a version control system, including functions to decide when to break or merge file pairs based on diff scoring criteria.

methods.name: int should_break(struct repository * r,struct diff_filespec * src,struct diff_filespec * dst,int break_score,int * merge_score_p)
methods.description: Determines whether a pair of files should be broken into delete and create operations based on diff scores and size criteria.

methods.name: void diffcore_break(struct repository * r,int break_score)
methods.description: Performs breaking of file pairs in the diff queue based on the break score, splitting them into delete and create pairs if necessary.

methods.name: void merge_broken(struct diff_filepair * p,struct diff_filepair * pp,struct diff_queue_struct * outq)
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair when appropriate.

methods.name: void diffcore_merge_broken(void)
methods.description: Iterates over the diff queue to find and merge broken file pairs where possible.
